integrity: The published top-Laplacian matrix, cyclic combinatorial type, facets and normalized lattice volume are credited as prior. Ellipsoid, polar, Santaló, covariance and comparison formulas have same-model mathematical review only; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Canonical alternating face orientation, even boundary dimension at least two, intrinsic Euclidean metric; no result for arbitrary top-face reorientation, odd boundary dimension or arbitrary simplicial complexes; finite computational checks cannot prove the infinite theorem. Historical priority provisional.
title: Exact Euclidean and Santaló geometry of even simplex-boundary Laplacian polytopes
